main_text.p: nem? Si enim principia habet, utiq; aptissima est ad docendum. Annon eadem est maximè expetenda? Nam est multò excellentior philosophiâ. Denique annon Theologia omnibus disciplinis philosophicis præcipit? Præcipit autem, dum omnia ad gloriam Dei juxta normam Scriptura dirigere jubet.
Hæc est nostra de SS.Theologia sentential, quam subjicimus censura philosophorum & Theologorum, parati cedere iis, qui meliora in medium ponent.
main_text.head: PERORATIO HEXI-LOGIÆ.
main_text.p: Hexilogiæ peroratio.HÆc sunt hujus secundi præcogniti philosophici pomœria, hi fines. Quare nihil jam superest tra-ctandum[?] de hac materia. Omnia enim congesimus, quæ de habitibus intellectualibus præcognoscenda ve-niunt. Colophonis loco adjiciam ἀποχρηματισμὸν[?] totius tractationis, itemque usum hexilogiæ uno atque altero verbo in-dicabo.

page.notes: The Greek word after "Colophonis loco adjiciam" is only partly legible; the reading ἀποχρηματισμὸν is a best guess. "tra-ctandum" is also uncertain: the ligature after the hyphen is hard to read. The left margin strip belongs to the neighbouring page and was left out. The line "pomœria,hi fines" is printed without a space after the comma; it is written with a space here. No catchword or signature is visible.
